topic: The mechanics of credit score reporting frequency
hook: 3 Facts About Your Credit Score Updates

plan_reasons.angle: educational until there is data on the other types

caption:
Your credit score is not updated in real-time. Knowing that lenders report data on a monthly cycle can help you manage your expectations when monitoring your progress. Regular reviews are more effective than daily checks. How often do you check your credit report? Save this for later and share it with someone who needs it. #creditscore #financialhealth #personalfinance #creditreport #financialliteracy #rxtfinancial

Educational content only. This is not personalised financial advice.
